title: UAAP: Ateneo women get back at Adamson to stay in Final 4 hunt
summary: Ateneo de Manila University scored a crucial 70-52 triumph over Adamson University in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament, Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum.
